reportTitle: Phase 7A.8.1B Custom Dictionary Activation API, Transaction Persistence & Safe Three-Mode Switching Verification Matrix

scenarios.title: activates custom dictionary from valid SQLite database and updates active.json
invariants: Copies candidate database to staging via VACUUM INTO
Publishes snapshot to custom-snapshots directory
Acquires active snapshot lease (leases=1)
Persists CustomActiveMetadata with schemaVersion 1 and activeMode='custom'
Lookups resolve against custom dictionary

scenarios.title: safely switches from custom to fixture mode, releasing snapshot lease and unlinking active.json
invariants: Unlinks active.json on fixture transition
Decrements snapshot lease count to 0
Closes custom database connection
Reverts dictionary lookups to sqlite-fixture fallback

scenarios.title: switches mode from custom to managed-ecdict, leasing ECDICT and releasing custom lease
invariants: Opens managed ECDICT database
Updates active.json to activeMode='managed-ecdict'
Drains prior custom snapshot lease to 0
Dictionary queries resolve against ECDICT corpus

scenarios.title: switches mode from managed-ecdict to custom using published snapshotId
invariants: Adopts existing published snapshot without re-copying or re-validating raw source
Increments custom snapshot lease to 1
Updates active.json to activeMode='custom'
Dictionary queries resolve against custom dictionary

scenarios.title: performs hot-swap between custom-A and custom-B with lease handoff and uninterrupted queries
invariants: Seamless transfer between snapshots
Snapshot A lease decrements from 1 to 0
Snapshot B lease increments from 0 to 1
Queries immediately resolve against Snapshot B

scenarios.title: rejects switch to managed-ecdict when ECDICT is not installed and preserves current mode
invariants: Throws Error('ECDICT database is not installed')
Preserves existing active mode and metadata unchanged

scenarios.title: rejects switch to custom with non-existent snapshotId and preserves current mode
invariants: Throws Error matching 'Published snapshot not found'
Preserves existing active mode and metadata unchanged

scenarios.title: rejects switch to custom without snapshotId when no snapshot is currently active
invariants: Throws Error matching 'snapshotId is required'
Preserves existing active mode and metadata unchanged

scenarios.title: enforces unified mutex rejecting concurrent operations with OperationInProgressError
invariants: Unified mutex across install, remove, activateCustom, selectMode
Second simultaneous operation immediately rejected with OperationInProgressError (409)

scenarios.title: removeManagedDatabase while Custom is active deletes only ECDICT files, leaving Custom active and active.json intact
invariants: Deletes installed-ecdict.json and managed ecdict database
Preserves active.json and activeMode='custom'
Preserves custom snapshot files and lease count (leases=1)
Custom lookups continue without interruption

scenarios.title: removeManagedDatabase while Managed ECDICT is active reverts to fixture and cleans all files
invariants: Deletes installed-ecdict.json and active.json
Closes managed ECDICT connection
Reverts DictionaryManager to fixture mode

scenarios.title: guarantees user source database is strictly read-only with identical size, hash and mtime
invariants: User raw database is never written, renamed, moved, or truncated
SHA-256 hash, byte size, and mtime before vs after activation are byte-for-byte identical

scenarios.title: verifies staging creation and atomic publish into custom-snapshots directory
invariants: Staging file created atomically with ownership record
Published atomically to custom-snapshots/custom-<id>.sqlite3
Staging files cleaned up upon publication

scenarios.title: rejects corrupt SQLite file before activation and preserves fixture mode
invariants: Worker thread validation detects header/schema corruption
Throws validation error
Leaves fixture mode active and cleans staging artifacts

scenarios.title: rejects custom SQLite database missing required tables before activation
invariants: Rejects database missing 'forms' table
Throws schema validation error
Prevents corrupt activation and cleans staging artifacts

scenarios.title: supports cancellation before commit boundary, aborting staging and leaving fixture intact
invariants: OperationManager.cancel() during staging/validation marks status='cancelled'
Purges staging files
Leaves pre-state dictionary untouched

scenarios.title: rejects cancellation attempt after commit boundary with OperationNotCancellableError
invariants: onCommitBoundary marks nonCancellable=true
Cancellation attempt throws OperationNotCancellableError
Activation commits to completion

scenarios.title: startup recovery verifies published snapshot and activates custom dictionary
invariants: Verifies published snapshot via SHA-256 and byte size against active.json
Acquires snapshot lease
Directly activates custom dictionary without touching raw user source path

scenarios.title: startup recovery detects corrupt snapshot file via sha256 mismatch and falls back to fixture
invariants: Detects tampered bytes on published snapshot
Falls back cleanly to fixture mode
Records recoveryError in status summary

scenarios.title: startup recovery detects missing custom snapshot file and records recoveryError
invariants: Detects absent snapshot file on disk
Falls back cleanly to fixture mode
Records recoveryError in status summary

scenarios.title: recovers committed custom activation when host config was not cleanly synced
invariants: Treats disk active.json as source of truth when settingsSyncState='pending'
Re-adopts snapshot and activates custom dictionary

scenarios.title: startup recovery cleanly activates custom mode when settings sync was confirmed
invariants: Activates custom mode when settingsSyncState='synced'
Leaves recoveryError as null

scenarios.title: active snapshot holds lease >= 1, protecting from unlinking, and drains on retirement
invariants: cleanupSnapshot() refuses to unlink snapshot while lease >= 1
Closing dictionary handle drains lease to 0
Subsequent cleanup successfully unlinks snapshot

scenarios.title: continuous lookup queries during mode switch never fail or throw DictionaryUnavailableError
invariants: Lookup loop concurrently executed during mode transition
Zero errors, zero thrown exceptions, 100% successful lookups

scenarios.title: rolls back active.json and closes candidate snapshot if DictionaryManager.activate throws
invariants: Restores previous active.json metadata
Closes candidate snapshot dictionary and drains lease
Retains pre-state dictionary functionality

scenarios.title: throws ActivationRollbackError preserving both errors if rollback compensation fails
invariants: Double fault scenario: activate fails and rollback write fails
Throws ActivationRollbackError containing originalError and rollbackError

scenarios.title: GET /api/dsh-word-lookup/dictionary/status returns all 3-mode status fields
invariants: Status includes activeMode, canActivateCustom, canSwitchMode, activeSnapshotId, customSnapshotStatus

scenarios.title: POST /activate-custom and POST /select-mode route handlers accept requests and enforce validation
invariants: Validates path, identity, mode, and snapshotId parameters
Dispatches requests through OperationManager mutex
Returns standard JSON protocol responses

scenarios.title: plugin dispose drains in-flight operations, unregisters all 7 routes, and releases leases
invariants: Disposer unregisters all 8 routes (1 lookup + 7 management)
Closes active dictionary handle and drains snapshot leases

scenarios.title: Real isolated DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 process E2E verification across all 8 routes
invariants: Unauthenticated request fence (401 on all 8 routes)
Authenticated browser session mounts client runtime
Zero initial external network requests
Full activate-custom and select-mode protocol gating (400, 405, 415)
Strict user SQLite file invariance (size and SHA-256 preserved)
Custom activation and successful lookup resolution (custom-local)
Seamless three-mode switching between custom, fixture, and custom
Cross-process restart recovery directly restoring custom mode
Safe reversion to fixture and clean teardown
